mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lesson ( lesson_id, title, grade, file_path, created_by, created_at ) VALUES ( #{lessonId}, #{title}, #{grade}, #{filePath}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT lesson_id AS lessonId, title, grade, file_path AS filePath, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt FROM lesson WHERE lesson_id = #{lessonId}
SELECT lesson_id AS lessonId, title, grade, file_path AS filePath, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt FROM lesson ORDER BY created_at DESC
